phase_target: Complete Phase 3: stable topology-dependent interaction laws

handoff_from.expected_input: resolved T7 manifold or resolved multi-manifold set from Pipeline 1
handoff_from.handoff_rule: Pipeline 2 does not recreate atomic closure. It consumes resolved topology objects and evolves their interaction ecology.
handoff_from.cycle_rule: For recursive equilibrium refinement, execute full-cycle recursion: Pipeline 1 T0→T7, then Pipeline 2 R0→R7, then return/de-resolve to T0 as needed for the next complete cycle. Do not max Pipeline 1 separately and then max Pipeline 2 separately.

dimensional_contract.declaration: Pipeline 2 is explicitly 5D manifold-facing and must operate across the same dimensional capacity as the 5D manifold architecture.

manifold_shape_contract.artifact_distribution_volume: 32x32x32 spatial occupancy domain unless explicitly upgraded
manifold_shape_contract.rule: Pipeline 2 never treats the manifold as a flat 2D/3D visualization. Every region must preserve artifact-channel, chirality/set-lift, shell/closure, spatial occupancy, and ecological memory interfaces.

five_interfaces.D1_spatial_occupancy: 3D volume-level distribution, overlap, adjacency, shell-facing geometry, local density migration.
five_interfaces.D2_shell_closure_topology: resolved shell, closure boundary, core/shell separation, closure identity preservation.
five_interfaces.D3_chirality_setlift: chirality seed/state, handedness, set-lift polarity, ancestry recoverability, chirality pressure.
five_interfaces.D4_artifact_channel: 11-channel structural artifact layer used as topology gates, registers, identity guards, and ecological interfaces.
five_interfaces.D5_recursive_ecology_memory: interaction history, coupling memory, perturbation recovery record, equilibrium convergence trace.

artifact_chirality_io_policy.summary: Pipeline 2 is read-dominant at the chirality/artifact seed level. It may read, gate, and record through artifact channels, but it may not freely rewrite the chirality seed or artifact identity.
artifact_chirality_io_policy.pipeline_1_policy: write-dominant during T0→T3 and closure-realization phases; reinforces chirality configuration and resolves atomic-profile topology.
artifact_chirality_io_policy.pipeline_2_policy: read-dominant ecological recursion; uses stabilized chirality configuration as authoritative constraint for allowed interactions.
allowed_operations: read chirality baseline and artifact-channel integrity
gate continuity exchange through artifact-channel compatibility
record interaction memory without mutating seed identity
apply limited equilibrium correction to smooth ecological noise
mark composite-candidate traces only when R5 composite testing explicitly authorizes it
forbidden_by_default: collapse two artifact systems into one without composite authorization
mutate topology class during ordinary ecology traversal
artifact_chirality_io_policy.write_gate: Only R5 Composite Topology Stabilization may request limited write authorization, and only to a separate composite register. Original manifold identities remain recoverable.

phase3_completion_definition.phase3_core_question: How do recursive topologies interact without losing organizational coherence?
phase3_completion_definition.completion_gate: Phase 3 is complete when interaction behavior is repeatable, topology-dependent, environmentally mediated, persistently stabilized, and identity-preserving across full-cycle recursion.
required_verified_capabilities: persistent corridor or shell-sharing retention when topology permits
controlled continuity transfer without chirality seed rewrite
stable composite topology candidate detection without identity collapse
failure_conditions: chirality seed overwrite during ordinary R0-R7 traversal
artifact-channel identity mutation outside authorized composite register
topology merger when identity preservation is required
interaction behavior becomes identical across topology classes

governing_invariants.recursive_recoverability: Every output must remain reverse-traversable into a recoverable ancestry state unless an instability test intentionally breaks the state.
governing_invariants.chirality_conservation: Pipeline 2 preserves chirality ancestry as a read-dominant invariant; it may measure, gate, and record against chirality, not rewrite it.
governing_invariants.admissibility: Interactions must emerge only when topology, shell ecology, chirality compatibility, and continuity bandwidth allow them.
governing_invariants.equilibrium_saturation: Coupling should converge toward an admissible equilibrium, not strengthen without bound.
governing_invariants.identity_in_ecology: A coupled ecology may become a higher-order system while preserving substructure identity maps.
governing_invariants.full_cycle_recursion: Preferred refinement cycle is Pipeline1 T0→T7 followed by Pipeline2 R0→R7, then de-resolution/return as needed for the next full cycle.

coupling_class_register.purpose: Classifies observed interaction as shell-sharing, bounded corridor, cyclic persistence, suppression, neutral coexistence, or composite candidate.
coupling_class_register.write_policy: May write ecology metadata only; may not rewrite source manifold artifact/chirality identity.

continuity_transfer_register.purpose: Tracks controlled exchange/redistribution across interaction surfaces.
continuity_transfer_register.write_policy: Records transfer measurements and gates; does not write to chirality seed.

corridor_memory_register.purpose: Stores bounded corridor survivability and recurrence traces for nitrogen-like topology classes.

shell_sharing_memory_register.purpose: Stores symmetric accommodation history for hydrogen-like topology classes.

environmental_arbitration_register.purpose: Tracks interaction preference, suppression, and competition in A+B+C+D ecology environments.

composite_candidate_register.purpose: Only R5 may write here. Stores higher-order coupled topology candidates while preserving original identity maps.
composite_candidate_register.write_policy: Authorized R5-only separate register; original manifold identities must remain recoverable.

pipeline_regions.name: Resolved Entry / Identity Registration
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Prevents false coupling by authenticating resolved Pipeline 1 outputs before ecological interaction.
five_dimensional_actions: D1: establish spatial occupancy boundaries and adjacency domain
D2: register shell/closure identity and persistence floor
D3: read chirality/set-lift ancestry baseline
D4: audit artifact-channel integrity
D5: initialize ecology memory registers

pipeline_regions.name: Interaction Surface Mapping
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Finds where topologies may interact without forcing interaction.
five_dimensional_actions: D1: map overlap, distance, adjacency, facing surfaces
D2: identify shell-sharing surfaces and closure compression zones
D3: compare chirality compatibility and chirality pressure
D4: identify artifact-channel gates that permit/suppress exchange
D5: write candidate interaction surfaces to coupling-class register

pipeline_regions.name: Controlled Continuity Transfer Gate
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Primary Phase 3 upgrade: allows measured continuity redistribution without seed rewrite or topology merger.
pipeline_regions.read_write_mode: gated ecological write to transfer registers; no chirality/artifact identity writes
five_dimensional_actions: D1: measure occupancy transfer and local density migration
D2: propagate shell influence while preserving closure integrity
D3: measure chirality flow pressure without rewriting chirality seed
D4: use artifact channels as gates/regulators
D5: record continuity exchange history and saturation trend
pipeline_regions.completion_metric: nonzero controlled transfer with high identity preservation

pipeline_regions.name: Persistent Coupling Memory
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Converts admissible temporary interaction into repeatable persistent ecology when topology permits.
five_dimensional_actions: D1: stabilize recurring overlap/shell/corridor geometry
D2: measure multi-cycle shell/corridor persistence
D3: verify chirality ancestry recoverability after coupling
D4: preserve artifact-channel identity while recording memory
D5: store coupling class, recurrence score, and saturation state
pipeline_regions.completion_metric: coupling survives repeated R0-R7 and full-cycle recursion without identity loss

pipeline_regions.name: Ecological Perturbation Probe
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Phase 4 bridge; used during Phase 3 only to test whether interaction persistence survives mild perturbation.
pipeline_regions.read_write_mode: read-dominant perturbation audit; records recovery only
five_dimensional_actions: D1: inject mild surface/occupancy stress
D2: measure closure deformation and recovery
D3: monitor chirality imbalance without rewriting seed
D4: verify artifact-channel guard rails under stress
D5: record recovery pathway and instability boundary
pipeline_regions.note: Full excitation theory belongs to Phase 4; here R4 only validates Phase 3 persistence robustness.

pipeline_regions.name: Composite Topology Candidate Gate
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Determines whether interacting manifolds are beginning to act as a higher-order ecology without erasing source identity.
pipeline_regions.read_write_mode: limited write authorization to separate composite_candidate_register only
five_dimensional_actions: D1: detect shared spatial scaffold
D2: detect higher-order closure ecology
D3: verify source chirality baselines remain recoverable
D4: preserve original artifact-channel identities; write only composite register
D5: measure composite persistence and reversibility
pipeline_regions.completion_metric: candidate higher-order behavior exists while original identities remain recoverable

pipeline_regions.name: Interaction Hierarchy / Environmental Arbitration
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Classifies preferences, suppression, competition, and equilibrium selection in pair and multi-manifold environments.
five_dimensional_actions: D1: map competing spatial interaction zones
D2: compare shell, corridor, cyclic, neutral, and suppression outcomes
D3: arbitrate chirality compatibility conflicts
D4: use artifact channels as compatibility gates
D5: record selected equilibrium and rejected alternatives
pipeline_regions.completion_metric: different topology pairings produce repeatable distinct outcomes

pipeline_regions.name: Stable Recursive Interaction Ecology Closure
pipeline_regions.phase3_role: Final Phase 3 closure state for persistent topology-dependent interaction laws.
pipeline_regions.read_write_mode: closure record; no chirality/artifact seed rewrite
five_dimensional_actions: D1: freeze final ecology geometry for audit/reversal
D2: verify closure identity and interaction class persistence
D3: verify chirality conservation and recoverability
D4: verify artifact-channel integrity
D5: output recursive ecology state with memory registers
pipeline_regions.completion_metric: R7 state can reverse toward R0/T0 with high chirality and identity correlation

H_plus_H.must_not: bounded nitrogen corridor, topology merger, runaway strengthening
H_plus_H.phase3_success: coupling persists across full-cycle recursion and saturates at stable equilibrium

N_plus_N.must_not: hydrogen-style only diffuse overlap, identity collapse
N_plus_N.phase3_success: corridor survives cycles and carries controlled continuity exchange

C6H6.must_not: collapse into six independent local cores
C6H6.phase3_success: cyclic continuity survives perturbation and ecology traversal

mixed_pairs.expected_coupling: hierarchy, suppression, compatibility, or neutral coexistence based on topology

A_B_C_D_environment.expected_coupling: multi-manifold arbitration; selected equilibrium or documented instability boundary
A_B_C_D_environment.phase3_success: ecology stabilizes or fails with interpretable cause

phase3_test_sequence.name: H+H controlled continuity exchange
phase3_test_sequence.gate: nonzero shell-sharing transfer, no merger, no runaway

phase3_test_sequence.name: C6H6 cyclic persistence under R4 probe
A+B+C+D multi-manifold arbitration
phase3_test_sequence.gate: stable recursive ecology or interpretable failure boundary

ready_when: P2v03-001 through P2v03-009 pass or produce interpretable failure boundaries
coupling classes remain distinct across H+H, N+N, C6H6, and mixed pairs
controlled continuity transfer is observed without chirality seed rewrite
R4 perturbation probe identifies recovery thresholds but does not require full excitation theory
phase4_handoff.phase4_begins_with: formal perturbation/excitation response using R4 as the gateway region
